email.subject: Discover Cafe 37: Your Perfect Kolkata Cafe & Restaurant
email.body:
Hello!

You might be looking for a cozy cafe and restaurant in Kolkata's Belgachia area. Cafe 37 is your local spot for delicious cafe dining, restaurant meals, and local takeaway options.

We're located at 64/1/45C, Belgachia Road, near SBI Bank, Milk Colony, Kolkata 700037, West Bengal, India.

Hours: 12 PM–11:30 PM (confirm with us for current hours)

Phone: +91 98308 64437
Email: cafe37restaurant@gmail.com

Visit us for a great dining experience!
